<h2 {...{

<li parentName="ol">{`Log in to `}<strong parentName="li">{`BigCommerce Admin`}</strong>{`.`}</li>

<li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Placement`}</strong>{`: `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`Footer`}</inlineCode></li>
<li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Location on page`}</strong>{`: `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`All pages`}</inlineCode></li>

<h2 {...{

<p>{`Copy this as a starting point and adjust per feature. Keys you don't include fall back to the theme defaults.`}</p>
<p>{`All features are `}<strong parentName="p">{`disabled by default`}</strong>{`. You only need to include the keys you want to enable.`}</p>

        "className": "language-html"
      }}>{`<script>
  window.supermarketThemeSettings = {
    urgency: {
      enabled: true,
      viewCount: { min: 8, max: 42 },
      viewRange: { min: 3, max: 15 },
      lastOrder: { min: 2, max: 60 },
      orderRange: { min: 5, max: 30 },
      refresh: 20000
    },
    cartGoal: {
      enabled: true,
      currency: 'USD',
      hideForGuests: false,
      items: [
        { amount: 50,  icon: 'shipping', label: 'Free Shipping' },
        { amount: 100, icon: 'discount', label: '10% Off' },
        { amount: 150, icon: 'gift',     label: 'Free Gift' }
      ]
    },
    recentSales: {
      enabled: true,
      source: 'best-sellers',
      timing: { delay: 8000, duration: 6000, interval: 20000, maxShows: 3 },
      position: 'bottom-left',
      pages: 'all',
      excludePages: ['/cart.php', '/checkout']
    },
    promo: {
      enabled: true,
      title: 'Special Offer',
      description: 'Get 15% off your first order!',
      coupon: 'WELCOME15',
      buttonText: 'Copy Code',
      delay: 10000,
      freqDays: 7
    },
    exit: {
      enabled: true,
      mode: 'discount',
      title: 'Wait! Before you go...',
      description: 'Here\\'s 10% off to help you decide.',
      coupon: 'STAY10',
      buttonText: 'Copy Code',
      buttonUrl: '',
      mobileDelay: 30000,
      freqDays: 7
    }
  };
</script>
`}</code></pre>

<h3 {...{
      "id": "newsletter-popup"
    }}>{`Newsletter Popup`}</h3>
<p>{`The existing Newsletter popup is `}<strong parentName="p">{`unchanged`}</strong>{` — all theme-editor settings (`}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`nl_popup_show`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`nl_popup_start`}</inlineCode>{`, `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`nl_popup_hide`}</inlineCode>{`) and the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`NL_POPUP_HIDE`}</inlineCode>{` cookie continue to work as before.`}</p>
<p>{`From theme `}<strong parentName="p">{`7.3.0`}</strong>{` onward, the newsletter popup is coordinated with the new social-proof popups through a priority queue so only one popup is shown at a time. The queue order (highest priority first) is: `}<strong parentName="p">{`Exit Intent`}</strong>{` > `}<strong parentName="p">{`Promo`}</strong>{` > `}<strong parentName="p">{`Newsletter`}</strong>{` > `}<strong parentName="p">{`Recent Sales`}</strong>{`. No configuration is required to enable this — it kicks in automatically when the new popups are active.`}</p>
<h2 {...{

<p>{`All features are disabled by default — no Script Manager snippet is needed if you don't want any social-proof widgets. If you previously had a snippet that enabled some features and want to revert, either remove the snippet or explicitly disable each feature:`}</p>

    recentSales: { enabled: false },
    promo:       { enabled: false },
    exit:        { enabled: false }
  };
</script>
`}</code></pre>
